scripts.build:all: bun run build:chrome && bun run build:firefox
scripts.start:firefox: bun run build:firefox && web-ext run --source-dir dist/firefox
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run build:all && bun run lint:firefox
scripts.package:chrome: bun run check && web-ext build --source-dir dist/chrome --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename youtube-essentials-chrome.zip --overwrite-dest
scripts.package:firefox: bun run check && web-ext build --source-dir dist/firefox --artifacts-dir artifacts --filename youtube-essentials-firefox.zip --overwrite-dest
